notes.title: ACHIEVEMENT FIX.
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just fix the bug you've mention about some of Steam Achievements.
Everything should work just perfect now!

Thank you so much for your feedback! If you have any other issues with the game - please share them with us, and we'd fix them ASAP!

Thank you!

notes.title: STEAM TRADING CARDS - COMING SOON!
notes.content:
[b]STEAM TRADING CARDS - COMING SOON![/b]

Hey guys!

We're excited to say a bunch of Steam community content (trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons, and animated content) is on the way and should - we hope - be available soon. Will provide an update as soon as we have any news! 


Please share your feedback in comments bellow!
